prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in after pet adoption was helpful and underpredicted (+13.3% vs +12.0%), but moving it to hand-off showed no clear effect and moving it after the waiting room made results worse (-3.9%). Account sync sign-in banners were also helpful (+2.7%).
Path clarity headline copy updates were helpful and underpredicted (+5.9% vs +1.0%), whereas general path copy simplification and time expectation banners showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%) and photo quality incentives (+7.6%) were helpful, though their predicted impacts (+8.0% and +10.0%) were too high.
Compact grid layouts for friend selection in pet adoption performed worse (-7.7%).
Progress trackers, sound notifications, split photo upload assistants, mascot welcome stages, and desktop spawn alerts showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, incentive: +7.6% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, layout: -7.7% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +3.0% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: +3.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +3.8% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +0.2% over 2 test(s)
- home, redesign: +5.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +2.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.8% over 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 70.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.4%

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Pet Controls Orientation Screen: Add a dedicated post-onboarding orientation screen showing how to summon, right-click, and control the desktop pet. (why: 3 support emails specifically asked how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing setup.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence: Place the sign-in step right after the adoption certificate stage so users attach their newly customized pet directly to their account. (why: 8 support messages reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, making early account attachment critical.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Recovery Callout: Add an explicit informational callout banner on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that their existing pets auto-sync upon login. (why: The top support theme with 8 emails concerns missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
3: [home, wait_info] Background Hatching Desktop Readiness Status: Provide real-time desktop shader readiness messaging and progress indicators while waiting for pet assets to build. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to spawn on desktop or app stall during setup; median wait time is 201s.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Story Intro Value Proposition Refresh: Update the story intro headline and body text to immediately emphasize quick setup and interactive desktop companionship. (why: First step drop-off is 21.0%, indicating users need clearer upfront motivation before committing to path choice.)
5: [finish, notification] First Interaction Desktop Notification Tip: Trigger a subtle timed desktop notification hint on the home intro screen pointing out the pet spawn location. (why: Support logs show 3 users experienced confusion over pets not showing up on desktop or where to click.)
